verified_metadata.title: What exactly is 'active matter'?
verified_metadata.abstract: As the study of active matter has developed into one of the most rapidly growing subfields of condensed matter physics, more and more kinds of physical systems have been included in this framework. While the word 'active' is often thought of as referring to self-propelled particles, it is also applied to a large variety of other systems such as non-polar active nematics or certain particles with non-reciprocal interactions. Developing novel forms of active matter, as attempted, e.g., in the framework of quantum active matter, requires a clear idea of what active matter is. Here, we critically discuss how the understanding of active matter has changed over time, what precisely a definition of 'active matter' can look like, and to what extent it is (still) possible to define active matter in a way that covers all systems that are commonly understood as active matter while distinguishing them from other driven systems. Moreover, we discuss the definition of an 'active field theory', where 'active' is used as an attribute of a theoretical model rather than of a physical system. We show that the usage of the term 'active' requires agreement on a coarse-grained viewpoint. We discuss the meaning of 'active' both in general terms and via the specific examples of chemically driven particles, ultrasound-driven particles, active nematics, particles with non-reciprocal interactions, intracellular phase separation, and quantum active matter.

sections.title: 作者信息
bullets: 作者：Michael te Vrugt、Benno Liebchen、Michael E. Cates；Mainz、TU Darmstadt、Cambridge。
官方快照：arXiv:2507.21621v1；32 页；cond-mat.soft/stat-mech、bio-ph、chem-ph；作者标注 preprint/comments welcome。
这是一篇概念与术语批判综述；目标是阐明分类边界，不是提出一种新的 active-particle dynamics。

sections.title: 摘要
bullets: “active=self-propelled”过窄，因为 active nematics、shakers、某些 nonreciprocal systems并无单粒子净推进；但“任何局域驱动 nonequilibrium system”又会把激光、ratchet 等大量对象纳入。
作者比较历史定义，提炼 nonequilibrium steady behavior、local energy influx、由该能流生成 motion/forces，以及有争议的 directionality 等判据。
核心结论不是给出唯一必要充分定义：activity 依赖 coarse-grained viewpoint，并非严格 observer-或resolution-independent property；分类是否有用取决于它能否揭示跨系统 emergent similarities。

sections.title: 背景
bullets: 术语为快速增长的领域提供共同身份，却也可能导致旧现象被不同社区重复发现；quantum active matter 等扩展尤其迫使研究者说明“active”增加了什么。
文章区分 descriptive definition（人们实际怎么用）与 prescriptive definition（应该怎么用），并借 family resemblance 解释为何边界案例难以用单一条件封闭。
对象层面的 active matter 与方程层面的 active field theory 不是同一命题：PDE 自身不“消耗能量”，其 active 标签取决于结构、来源或使用语境。

sections.title: 模型与方法
bullets: Section II 收集 2010–2024 六组代表定义，并用 Janus particles、birds、dry/wet active systems 检验彼此一致与冲突。
Section III 用 trajectory forward/backward probability ratio、entropy production、active Brownian dynamics 讨论 TRS；time-reversal parity of orientation 与保留哪些 variables 会改变可见 irreversibility。
Section IV 的比较表逐项标记 out of equilibrium、local energy influx、motion/forces generated、directionality 与 literature usage；它是概念诊断表，不是训练分类器。
Section V 从 gradient dynamics/Cahn–Hilliard 到 Active Model B+、nonreciprocal multi-field equations，检验“不能由 free energy 导出”是否足以定义 active field theory。
Section VI 以 chemical Janus 与 ultrasound propulsion 追踪 coarse-graining：显式包含 fuel/solvent/field 时动力学可守恒，积分掉环境后才出现 self-propulsion 或非互易有效项。
Section VII 处理 active nematics、nonreciprocity、intracellular LLPS 与 quantum active matter 四类边界案例。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
bullets: 作者认为 active systems 通常需要长期非平衡、局域能量流以及该能量流生成 motion/forces；directionality 有助排除 sedimentation/ratchets，却会误排 symmetric shakers 等公认案例。
Figure IV 的表显示 literature label 与逻辑 criteria并不完全一致：nonreciprocal lattice models、multi-temperature particles、Brownian ratchets等揭示任何单列条件都会有 false inclusion/exclusion。
nonconservative force 非必要也非充分；wet swimmer 可 force-free，odd/transverse mobility 也可见于 equilibrium-compatible magnetic systems。判断关键是完整循环是否做功及被积分掉的环境。
active field theory 的 nonvariational/TRS-breaking criterion富有生产力，但过宽会覆盖早于 active matter 的 driven PDE；有些 nonreciprocal gradient forms还能经变量/metric重写，形式外观不构成充分判据。
intracellular arrested coarsening/bubbly droplets 可由 reaction-driven active process或 passive kinetic arrest产生；相同 morphology 不能辨别 energy influx mechanism。
quantum 部分区分 analogy、mimicking 与 genuine realization；light-mediated nonreciprocity 在忽略 electromagnetic field 后看似 active，而显式包含 trap/source 时分类可能转为 driven particle in active bath。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
bullets: 全文主动拒绝唯一、完全成功的 definition；把其判据列表当成硬标准会违背结论。
“local”与“internal”依赖 observation scale：底部加热的 convection通常叫 driven，局域 laser heating可能数学同构，但语言直觉不同。
TRS breaking 必须指定 variables 和 reversal operation；只观察 position可能漏掉 orientation/fuel currents，或让 coarse-grained entropy production与 thermodynamic total不一致。
literature usage 本身具有历史/社区偏差；“通常被称为 active”不是自然界的客观 binary label。
active-field classification按 equation form可能因 variable transformation、effective free energy 非有界或 mobility 非正定而改变；形式可重写不保证 physical equilibrium。
2025 quantum-active案例多为 proposal、analogy或 driven-open setups；文章没有宣称已有普遍认可的 intrinsically self-propelled quantum particle。
引用 Google Scholar 约 5000 篇只说明标题词频趋势，不是经过去重和检索协议验证的文献计量。

sections.title: 复现与资源
bullets: 概念复核可重建 Figure IV：为每个 system 保存 physical boundary、energy source、retained variables、momentum reservoir、steady currents 与 community label。
TRS测试必须声明 orientation在 time reversal 下是否翻转，并比较 full-state 与 position-only trajectory entropy production。
field-theory案例需同时检查 variational representation、mobility positive-definiteness、free-energy boundedness、steady currents与microscopic derivation，不能只搜一个 nonreciprocal term。
边界案例应做 multiscale audit：先保留 fuel/solvent/light bath，再逐层 coarse-grain，记录 active label 在哪一步出现及哪些 entropy channels 被隐藏。

sections.title: 阅读指南
bullets: 先读 Sections II–IV 和 comparison table，理解为什么 self-propulsion、local energy 和 directionality 都各有反例。
再读 V–VI：active 是模型的属性还是被模型描述系统的属性，取决于 coarse-graining provenance。
最后读 VII–VIII；把 nonreciprocal、LLPS 与 quantum examples 当作定义压力测试，而不是等待作者给出一句终极定义。
